from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory
from flask_cors import CORS
import os
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from lxml import etree
import json
import uuid
import hmac
import hashlib
import base64

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder='.')
CORS(app)

RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT = '12100011-11345707'
RECIPIENT_NAME = 'Zsebeházi Andrea'
RECIPIENT_IBAN = 'HU42121000111134570700000000'

OTP_API_KEY = os.getenv('OTP_API_KEY', '')
OTP_API_SECRET = os.getenv('OTP_API_SECRET', '')
OTP_MERCHANT_ID = os.getenv('OTP_MERCHANT_ID', '')
SIMPLEPAY_MERCHANT = os.getenv('SIMPLEPAY_MERCHANT', '')
SIMPLEPAY_SECRET_KEY = os.getenv('SIMPLEPAY_SECRET_KEY', '')
BILLINGO_API_KEY = os.getenv('BILLINGO_API_KEY', '')
GIRO_PARTICIPANT_ID = os.getenv('GIRO_PARTICIPANT_ID', '')
GIRO_API_URL = os.getenv('GIRO_API_URL', '')

def generate_iso20022_pain013_xml(amount, recipient_name, recipient_iban, reference, transaction_id, debtor_iban=''):
    nsmap = {
        None: 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.013.001.07',
        'xsi': ''
    }
    
    document = etree.Element('Document', nsmap=nsmap)
    
    cdt_pmnt_actvtn_req = etree.SubElement(document, 'CdtrPmtActvtnReq')
    
    grp_hdr = etree.SubElement(cdt_pmnt_actvtn_req, 'GrpHdr')
    msg_id = etree.SubElement(grp_hdr, 'MsgId')
    msg_id.text = transaction_id
    cre_dt_tm = etree.SubElement(grp_hdr, 'CreDtTm')
    cre_dt_tm.text = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'
    nb_of_txs = etree.SubElement(grp_hdr, 'NbOfTxs')
    nb_of_txs.text = '1'
    ctrl_sum = etree.SubElement(grp_hdr, 'CtrlSum')
    ctrl_sum.text = str(float(amount))
    initg_pty = etree.SubElement(grp_hdr, 'InitgPty')
    initg_nm = etree.SubElement(initg_pty, 'Nm')
    initg_nm.text = recipient_name
    
    pmnt_inf = etree.SubElement(cdt_pmnt_actvtn_req, 'PmtInf')
    pmnt_inf_id = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'PmtInfId')
    pmnt_inf_id.text = transaction_id + '-INF'
    pmnt_mtd = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'PmtMtd')
    pmnt_mtd.text = 'TRF'
    
    nb_of_txs_inf = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'NbOfTxs')
    nb_of_txs_inf.text = '1'
    ctrl_sum_inf = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'CtrlSum')
    ctrl_sum_inf.text = str(float(amount))
    
    pmnt_tp_inf = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'PmtTpInf')
    svc_lvl = etree.SubElement(pmnt_tp_inf, 'SvcLvl')
    svc_cd = etree.SubElement(svc_lvl, 'Cd')
    svc_cd.text = 'INST'
    
    reqd_exctn_dt = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'ReqdExctnDt')
    dt_el = etree.SubElement(reqd_exctn_dt, 'Dt')
    dt_el.text = datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    cdtr = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'Cdtr')
    cdtr_nm = etree.SubElement(cdtr, 'Nm')
    cdtr_nm.text = recipient_name
    
    cdtr_acct = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'CdtrAcct')
    cdtr_id = etree.SubElement(cdtr_acct, 'Id')
    cdtr_iban_el = etree.SubElement(cdtr_id, 'IBAN')
    cdtr_iban_el.text = recipient_iban
    
    cdtr_agt = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'CdtrAgt')
    fin_instn_id = etree.SubElement(cdtr_agt, 'FinInstnId')
    bic = etree.SubElement(fin_instn_id, 'BIC')
    bic.text = 'OTPVHUHB'
    
    cdt_trf_tx = etree.SubElement(pmnt_inf, 'CdtTrfTx')
    
    pmnt_id = etree.SubElement(cdt_trf_tx, 'PmtId')
    instr_id = etree.SubElement(pmnt_id, 'InstrId')
    instr_id.text = transaction_id
    end_to_end_id = etree.SubElement(pmnt_id, 'EndToEndId')
    end_to_end_id.text = transaction_id
    
    pmnt_tp_inf_tx = etree.SubElement(cdt_trf_tx, 'PmtTpInf')
    svc_lvl_tx = etree.SubElement(pmnt_tp_inf_tx, 'SvcLvl')
    svc_cd_tx = etree.SubElement(svc_lvl_tx, 'Cd')
    svc_cd_tx.text = 'INST'
    
    amt_el = etree.SubElement(cdt_trf_tx, 'Amt')
    instd_amt = etree.SubElement(amt_el, 'InstdAmt', Ccy='HUF')
    instd_amt.text = str(float(amount))
    
    if debtor_iban:
        dbtr = etree.SubElement(cdt_trf_tx, 'Dbtr')
        dbtr_nm = etree.SubElement(dbtr, 'Nm')
        dbtr_nm.text = 'Customer'
        
        dbtr_acct = etree.SubElement(cdt_trf_tx, 'DbtrAcct')
        dbtr_id = etree.SubElement(dbtr_acct, 'Id')
        dbtr_iban_el = etree.SubElement(dbtr_id, 'IBAN')
        dbtr_iban_el.text = debtor_iban
    
    rmt_inf = etree.SubElement(cdt_trf_tx, 'RmtInf')
    ustrd = etree.SubElement(rmt_inf, 'Ustrd')
    ustrd.text = reference
    
    xml_string = etree.tostring(document, pretty_print=True, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')
    return xml_string

def calculate_simplepay_signature(payload_dict, secret_key):
    json_str = json.dumps(payload_dict, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
    json_str_escaped = json_str.replace('/', '\\/')
    
    signature_bytes = hmac.new(
        secret_key.encode('utf-8'),
        json_str_escaped.encode('utf-8'),
        hashlib.sha384
    ).digest()
    
    signature_b64 = base64.b64encode(signature_bytes).decode('utf-8')
    return signature_b64

def initiate_simplepay_payment_request(amount, reference, transaction_id):
    if not SIMPLEPAY_MERCHANT or not SIMPLEPAY_SECRET_KEY:
        return {'success': False, 'error': 'SimplePay credentials not configured'}
    
    simplepay_endpoint = ''
    
    salt = str(uuid.uuid4()).replace('-', '')
    timeout = (datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00')
    
    payload = {
        'salt': salt,
        'merchant': SIMPLEPAY_MERCHANT,
        'orderRef': transaction_id,
        'currency': 'HUF',
        'total': int(float(amount)),
        'timeout': timeout,
        'methods': ['CARD'],
        'language': 'HU',
        'url': f'',
        'invoice': {
            'name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'country': 'hu',
            'city': '',
            'zip': '',
            'address': ''
        },
        'items': [
            {
                'ref': 'item1',
                'title': reference,
                'amount': int(float(amount)),
                'price': int(float(amount)),
                'tax': 0
            }
        ]
    }
    
    signature = calculate_simplepay_signature(payload, SIMPLEPAY_SECRET_KEY)
    
    headers = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json',
        'Signature': signature
    }
    
    try:
        response = requests.post(simplepay_endpoint, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            result = response.json()
            return {'success': True, 'data': result}
        else:
            return {'success': False, 'error': f'SimplePay API error: {response.status_code}', 'details': response.text}
    except Exception as e:
        return {'success': False, 'error': str(e)}

def initiate_giro_instant_payment(amount, recipient_name, recipient_iban, reference, transaction_id):
    if not GIRO_PARTICIPANT_ID:
        return {'success': False, 'error': 'GIRO credentials not configured'}
    
    pain013_xml = generate_iso20022_pain013_xml(
        amount=amount,
        recipient_name=recipient_name,
        recipient_iban=recipient_iban,
        reference=reference,
        transaction_id=transaction_id
    )
    
    headers = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/xml',
        'Accept': 'application/xml',
        'X-Participant-ID': GIRO_PARTICIPANT_ID
    }
    
    try:
        response = requests.post(GIRO_API_URL, data=pain013_xml, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        if response.status_code in [200, 201, 202]:
            return {'success': True, 'data': {'transaction_id': transaction_id, 'status': 'sent'}}
        else:
            return {'success': False, 'error': f'GIRO API error: {response.status_code}', 'details': response.text}
    except Exception as e:
        return {'success': False, 'error': str(e)}

def generate_hungarian_bank_deeplink(amount, reference, bank='otp'):
    base_url = ''
    params = {}
    
    if bank == 'otp':
        base_url = 'otpbankhu://'
        params = {
            'target': 'payment',
            'account': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'amount': str(amount),
            'name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'message': reference
        }
    elif bank == 'k&h':
        base_url = 'khbankhu://'
        params = {
            'action': 'transfer',
            'beneficiary_account': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'amount': str(amount),
            'beneficiary_name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'description': reference
        }
    elif bank == 'erste':
        base_url = 'erstehu://'
        params = {
            'type': 'transfer',
            'to_account': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'sum': str(amount),
            'to_name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'note': reference
        }
    elif bank == 'raiffeisen':
        base_url = 'raiffeisenhu://'
        params = {
            'transfer': 'new',
            'account_number': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'amount': str(amount),
            'payee_name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'comment': reference
        }
    elif bank == 'unicredit':
        base_url = 'unicredithu://'
        params = {
            'action': 'pay',
            'account': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'value': str(amount),
            'recipient': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'reference': reference
        }
    elif bank == 'cib':
        base_url = 'cibhu://'
        params = {
            'transfer': 'instant',
            'to': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'amount': str(amount),
            'name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'message': reference
        }
    else:
        base_url = 'intent://payment'
        params = {
            'account': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
            'amount': str(amount),
            'name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
            'message': reference
        }
        query_string = '&'.join([f'{k}={v}' for k, v in params.items()])
        return f'{base_url}?{query_string}#Intent;scheme=bankapp;action=android.intent.action.VIEW;end;'
    
    query_string = '&'.join([f'{k}={v}' for k, v in params.items()])
    return f'{base_url}?{query_string}'

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return send_from_directory('.', 'index.html')

@app.route('/api/payment/initiate', methods=['POST'])
def initiate_payment():
    try:
        data = request.json
        amount = str(data.get('amount', '0'))
        reference = data.get('reference', '')
        payment_method = data.get('method', 'deeplink')
        bank = data.get('bank', 'otp')
        
        if not amount or float(amount) <= 0:
            return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': 'Invalid amount'}), 400
        
        if not reference:
            return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': 'Reference is required'}), 400
        
        transaction_id = 'ZSEBIBABA-' + datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S') + '-' + str(uuid.uuid4())[:8].upper()
        
        iso20022_xml = generate_iso20022_pain013_xml(
            amount=amount,
            recipient_name=RECIPIENT_NAME,
            recipient_iban=RECIPIENT_IBAN,
            reference=reference,
            transaction_id=transaction_id
        )
        
        response_data = {
            'success': True,
            'transaction_id': transaction_id,
            'iso20022_xml': iso20022_xml.decode('utf-8'),
            'recipient': {
                'name': RECIPIENT_NAME,
                'account': RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT,
                'iban': RECIPIENT_IBAN
            },
            'amount': amount,
            'reference': reference
        }
        
        if payment_method == 'simplepay':
            simplepay_result = initiate_simplepay_payment_request(amount, reference, transaction_id)
            if simplepay_result['success']:
                response_data['simplepay_payment_url'] = simplepay_result['data'].get('paymentUrl', '')
                response_data['redirect_url'] = simplepay_result['data'].get('paymentUrl', '')
            else:
                response_data['simplepay_error'] = simplepay_result.get('error', 'Unknown error')
                deeplink = generate_hungarian_bank_deeplink(amount, reference, bank)
                response_data['deeplink'] = deeplink
                response_data['redirect_url'] = deeplink
        
        elif payment_method == 'giro':
            giro_result = initiate_giro_instant_payment(amount, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_IBAN, reference, transaction_id)
            if giro_result['success']:
                response_data['giro_status'] = 'sent'
                response_data['giro_transaction_id'] = transaction_id
                deeplink = generate_hungarian_bank_deeplink(amount, reference, bank)
                response_data['deeplink'] = deeplink
                response_data['redirect_url'] = deeplink
            else:
                response_data['giro_error'] = giro_result.get('error', 'Unknown error')
                deeplink = generate_hungarian_bank_deeplink(amount, reference, bank)
                response_data['deeplink'] = deeplink
                response_data['redirect_url'] = deeplink
        
        else:
            deeplink = generate_hungarian_bank_deeplink(amount, reference, bank)
            response_data['deeplink'] = deeplink
            response_data['redirect_url'] = deeplink
        
        return jsonify(response_data), 200
    
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': str(e)}), 500

@app.route('/api/payment/callback', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def payment_callback():
    try:
        if request.method == 'POST':
            data = request.json or request.form.to_dict()
        else:
            data = request.args.to_dict()
        
        signature_header = request.headers.get('Signature', '')
        
        if signature_header and SIMPLEPAY_SECRET_KEY:
            calculated_signature = calculate_simplepay_signature(data, SIMPLEPAY_SECRET_KEY)
            if signature_header != calculated_signature:
                return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': 'Invalid signature'}), 403
        
        return jsonify({
            'success': True,
            'message': 'Payment callback received',
            'data': data
        }), 200
    
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': str(e)}), 500

@app.route('/api/payment/status/<transaction_id>', methods=['GET'])
def payment_status(transaction_id):
    return jsonify({
        'success': True,
        'transaction_id': transaction_id,
        'status': 'pending',
        'message': 'Payment status check'
    }), 200

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=False)

def calculate_simplepay_signature(payload_dict, secret_key):
    json_str = json.dumps(payload_dict, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
    json_str_escaped = json_str.replace('/', '\\/')
    
    signature_bytes = hmac.new(
        secret_key.encode('utf-8'),
        json_str_escaped.encode('utf-8'),
        hashlib.sha384
    ).digest()
    
    signature_b64 = base64.b64encode(signature_bytes).decode('utf-8')
    return signature_b64
